reason: Resolve inconsistent first-run response instructions, expose bounded execution-channel metadata, and strengthen evidence replay and journal failure handling. Five of six first-run Markdown bodies exceeded the original 6000-byte task budget. One report denied current server/provider use although read calls occurred; the normalized model-visible results did not expose server identity. Preserve those results; do not change facts or relabel the first run as compliant.

response_contract.format: JSON envelope containing task_id, report_markdown, conclusion, citations
response_contract.oversize_behavior: retain the candidate in its model observation and record a failed task; never silently truncate or automatically rewrite

execution_metadata: Each task receives its selected configured channel. MCP identity and negotiated protocol come from successful startup, SDK identity from the pinned dependency; only successful tool observations establish reads. No answer keys or previous task outputs are supplied.
review: Same-project AI-assisted source review. Not independent human labels. Actual end-user acceptance is unmeasured.
scope: Same six intents, immutable source files, lanes and model deployment, fresh context per task. No new provider writes, no customer or Shuwen data. The before/after observations are not a randomized causal comparison or a new independent task population.
